author: Claude (AI assistant) - reference A, AI-written; must be paired with an independent reference B by a team member
note: outline is the test-set repository whose folders are organised by tier (app/, server/, shared/) while its functional blocks cut across the tiers (rq1-protocol criterion 4), so this reference assigns individual files. docs/ARCHITECTURE.md gives the tiers; the functional blocks follow the API resources (server/routes/api/*), models, scenes and plugins. Assignment rules, applied in order: (1) folder rules: shared|app|server/editor -> Editor; server|shared/collaboration -> Real-time collaboration; server/emails -> Notifications; server/converters -> Import and export; server/storage -> Attachments; server/mcp -> Integrations; server/migrations, logging, services, config, scripts -> API server; each plugins/<name> by what it is (auth providers, integrations, Notion/Slab importers, storage, Postgres search). (2) Whole words of the file name and its folder (camelCase split, so Spinner is not pin and startup is not star; the tier folders app/server/shared are not words), first match wins: comment, reaction; share, shared, access, membership, permission, policy; search; import, export, operation; collaboration, websocket, presence; notification, subscription, email; auth, authorize, login, logout, oauth, key, session, passkey; attachment, upload, avatar, storage; user, team, group, invite, preference, emoji, onboarding, profile, member; integration, webhook, unfurl, embed, plugin, hover (link previews); collection; document, revision, template, draft, archive, trash, star, pin, views, publish, backlink, relationship, suggestion, history (plurals included). (3) Otherwise app/ -> Web app shell, server/ -> API server, shared/ -> Shared utilities. Root configuration files are left unassigned. Written without any ArchTime output for this repository (it has not been mined).
sources: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md (frontend: React + MobX scenes, stores, models; backend: Koa routes, commands, models, policies, presenters, queues; shared: editor, i18n, utils)
server/routes/api/* (one folder per API resource), server/queues/processors/*, plugins/*/plugin.json

components.name: Documents
components.responsibility: Documents and their lifecycle: create, edit, publish, move, archive, delete and restore, revisions and history, templates, drafts, stars, pins, views, backlinks and document relationships.

components.name: Collections
components.responsibility: Collections that group documents: structure, ordering, settings and their pages.

components.name: Editor
components.responsibility: The ProseMirror-based rich-text editor shared by client and server: schema, marks, nodes, commands, plugins, and its React components.
evidence: ARCHITECTURE.md: shared/editor is the ProseMirror text editor; app/editor its React components

components.name: Real-time collaboration
components.responsibility: Multiplayer editing (Y.js collaboration server), websockets and presence.

components.name: Search
components.responsibility: Full-text search of documents and collections, search history, and the Postgres search plugin.

components.name: Comments and reactions
components.responsibility: Comment threads on documents and emoji reactions.

components.name: Sharing and access control
components.responsibility: Authorization policies (cancan), public shares, user and group memberships of documents and collections, access requests.

components.name: Users, teams and groups
components.responsibility: User accounts and profiles, workspaces (teams), groups, invitations, preferences, custom emojis and onboarding.

components.name: Authentication and API access
components.responsibility: Sign-in (email magic link, passkeys, Google, Azure, OIDC), sessions, API keys and the OAuth provider for third-party clients.

components.name: Notifications and email
components.responsibility: In-app notifications, document subscriptions and transactional emails.

components.name: Import and export
components.responsibility: Importing from Markdown, JSON, Notion and Slab, exporting workspaces and collections (file operations), and document format converters.

components.name: Attachments and file storage
components.responsibility: Uploaded files and images, avatars and the storage back ends (local, S3).

components.name: Integrations
components.responsibility: Third-party integrations as plugins (Slack, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Linear, Figma, Zapier, webhooks, link unfurling, diagrams, analytics), integration settings and the MCP server.

components.name: API server and background jobs
components.responsibility: Koa API server set-up, routing and middlewares, event bus and queue infrastructure, services (web, worker, cron), configuration, logging, database migrations and base models.

components.name: Web app shell
components.responsibility: The React / MobX application frame: routes, root stores and base models, layout, sidebar, navigation, settings scenes, generic components, hooks, menus and utilities.

components.name: Shared utilities and styles
components.responsibility: Code shared by client and server: utilities, types, styles, shared components, i18n set-up and constants.
